title: 轨道力学bug，与空间站对齐轨道后关闭匹配速度设置，空间站会迅速加速远离
description: 轨道力学bug，与空间站对齐轨道后关闭匹配速度设置，空间站会迅速加速远离
evidence: Orbital mechanics ar major BS: How come, that when i fly right up to the venusian orbital station and i perfectly align my orbit to it (with the provided match speed setting) it rapidly acellerates away from me the moment i disable the setting? we share the exact same orbit, it should at best drift very slowly towards or away from me. Does it not like me? does it use its thrusters to boost away from me?

evidence_items.quote: Orbital mechanics ar major BS: How come, that when i fly right up to the venusian orbital station and i perfectly align my orbit to it (with the provided match speed setting) it rapidly acellerates away from me the moment i disable the setting? we share the exact same orbit, it should at best drift very slowly towards or away from me. Does it not like me? does it use its thrusters to boost away from me?
evidence_items.description: 轨道力学bug，与空间站对齐轨道后关闭匹配速度设置，空间站会迅速加速远离
evidence_items.quote_zh: 轨道力学简直是胡扯：为什么当我飞到金星轨道站正前方，并且（用提供的匹配速度设置）完美地将我的轨道与它对齐时，一旦我禁用该设置，它就会迅速加速远离我？我们共享完全相同的轨道，它最多应该非常缓慢地朝我漂来或漂离我。它是不喜欢我吗？它是用推进器加速远离我吗？
